label: Bible Study
prompt: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to _____;
verse: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;
note: From the 'season' poem the Byrds turned into the 1965 hit 'Turn! Turn! Turn!'

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into _____: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
verse: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
note: Mourning swapped for dancing, sackcloth for gladness — God runs a generous wardrobe exchange.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And she put the _____ of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:
verse: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:
note: Rebekah's costume department: goatskins on Jacob's hands to pass for hairy Esau before his blind father.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But the wicked are like the _____ sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.
verse: But the wicked are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.
note: The restless sea keeps churning up mud — Isaiah's picture of a life with no peace.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her _____ is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth.
verse: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth.
note: Silent as a sheep before her 'shearers' — the Ethiopian eunuch was reading this very passage when Philip arrived (Acts 8:32).
